feature_notes.envelope_peak: maximum of the Hilbert envelope (relative, always >= 0)
feature_notes.signed_peak: amplitude of the largest absolute sample, sign kept
feature_notes.peak_offset: offset of the largest absolute sample from the pick

alignment.note: windows shifted to the best match with a waveform template estimated from the data; match is the signed correlation (negative = reversed polarity); one global template cannot follow a waveform that changes shape continuously (a thin-bed wedge)

Volve ST10010 PSDM full stack (3-41 degrees), depth-to-time converted, 4 ms; domain TIME and quantity AMPLITUDE as stated by the user from the text header; polarity unknown (not stated in the headers)

8 interpreted surfaces, at most 3500 picks each (every k-th pick of the file); the Hugin Fm top and base were picked on the near stack, the others on the full stack, and all windows come from the full stack

categories.note: names are read from the interpreters' horizon file names; no formation is added where the name has none (Utsira, Hod), and BCU is expanded to Base Cretaceous Unconformity from general knowledge, not from the files
